categoryExceptions.reason: Themes intentionally reshape Spotify-owned DOM and CSS. They are compatibility-tested as a separate category with theme-report instead of being presented as stdlib-insulated feature modules.

exceptions.reason: Store is the recovery path used to repair stdlib itself, so it cannot require stdlib to boot.
This is Store's single recovery-tier adapter around the wrapper runtime.
This is Manager's single recovery-tier adapter around the wrapper runtime, shared by the normal and plain-DOM recovery surfaces.
Visual ad removal necessarily identifies Spotify-owned ad containers after preventive slot blocking has run.
Bookmark still carries two legacy Spotify typography/play-button selectors inside its owned panel; migrate these to owned classes.
Bookmark must inspect the active Spotify route to capture its title and artwork; its remaining legacy presentation classes are tracked here too.
The module's purpose requires correcting Spotify's native window-control spacer when the shell controls are hidden.
Keyboard spatial navigation traverses Spotify-owned focusable rows, library items, and scroll viewports by design.
Loop markers attach to Spotify's playback progress bar; the legacy context-menu markup remains identified migration debt.
The port still adapts a small set of client typography, dropdown, and main-view layout classes.
The full-page lyrics route needs the live Spotify main-view scroll host.
The faithful port still names Spotify typography classes in its option rows; migrate these to owned primitives.
Lyrics pages synchronize against Spotify's main viewport; legacy typography classes remain identified migration debt.
Lyrics replacement must detect and suppress Spotify's native lyrics playbar control.
One legacy dropdown class remains in the ported settings surface and is tracked for primitive migration.
The route tab bar portals into Spotify's topbar and follows its main-view observer geometry.
Trashbin observes Spotify's native skip-back control to distinguish explicit replay from automatic track changes.
